description: This file contains the implementation of the ApplicationContext class and related classes for managing application lifecycle states, parameters, and synchronization primitives within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for setting and getting application state, session IDs, intents, and lifecycle parameters.

classes.name: ApplicationContext
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle state, parameters, and synchronization for a plugin within WPEFramework.

classes.name: ApplicationLaunchParams
classes.description: Holds parameters related to launching an application, including app ID, intent, arguments, target state, and runtime configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationKillParams
classes.description: Holds parameters related to killing an application, such as whether to force kill.

methods.name: ApplicationContext()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the application context with default values and setting up synchronization primitives.

methods.name: ~ApplicationContext()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up allocated state.

methods.name: setAppInstanceId
methods.description: Sets the application instance ID.

methods.name: setActiveSessionId
methods.description: Sets the active session ID.

methods.name: setMostRecentIntent
methods.description: Sets the most recent intent string.

methods.name: setLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state pointer.

methods.name: setTargetLifecycleState
methods.description: Sets the target lifecycle state.

methods.name: setStateChangeId
methods.description: Sets the state change identifier.

methods.name: setApplicationLaunchParams
methods.description: Sets the launch parameters for the application.

methods.name: setApplicationKillParams
methods.description: Sets the kill parameters for the application.

methods.name: getAppId
methods.description: Returns the application ID.

methods.name: getAppInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the application instance ID.

methods.name: getCurrentLifecycleState
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state by invoking getValue() on the state object.

methods.name: getLastLifecycleStateChangeTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last lifecycle state change.

methods.name: getActiveSessionId
methods.description: Returns the active session ID.

methods.name: getTargetLifecycleState
methods.description: Returns the target lifecycle state.

methods.name: getMostRecentIntent
methods.description: Returns the most recent intent string.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state pointer.

methods.name: getStateChangeId
methods.description: Returns the current state change ID.

methods.name: getApplicationLaunchParams
methods.description: Returns a reference to the launch parameters object.

methods.name: getApplicationKillParams
methods.description: Returns a reference to the kill parameters object.
